candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record explicitly states the bleeding source is the right ureteral orifice and later the right renal pelvis, with a ureteroarterial fistula being the most likely diagnosis. Hemorrhagic cystitis, radiation-induced, would imply bleeding from the bladder due to radiation, which is not supported as the primary cause of the massive hematuria described.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: The candidate describes a different etiology and location of bleeding.
